goal: Group presence tweaks: gray icon after leaving a group, auto-join the meeting muted on enter, drag a group from anywhere inside it except people
summary: (1) SocialGraph toneFor() returns 'stone' for away users, so after leaving a group your circle (and anyone else's who left) eases to gray while it lingers in the bubble. (2) Entering a room already connects you to the room's voice (LiveKit) muted; the separate 'Join voice' state (Voice.micJoined, headphones icon) is gone, so the dock and minimized widget show Mute/Unmute from the start. (3) Group drag already existed; a person's hit area was 1.2x their drawn disc, so in a crowded bubble most of the gaps grabbed a person. nodeAt and nodePointerAreaPaint now share hitRadius() = the drawn radius, so any press inside a bubble that isn't on a person drags the bubble.
decisions: Removed Voice.micJoined rather than setting it true on join: with everyone joining muted it would always be true while in a room.

Did not publish a muted mic track on enter: that would prompt for mic permission on every room entry. LiveKit already reports connected participants without a mic as muted ('off'), so others see you as in the meeting and muted.

verification.manual: Local in-memory demo on :3117: dragged CS3251 bubble from a gap between members (moved as a group); entered Startup Ideas, dock showed 'Unmute' and my member 'muted'; left the room, my circle turned gray in the bubble. LiveKit mode not tested (no keys).

next_steps: Test with LiveKit keys: enter a room, confirm you hear others while muted and that the first Unmute prompts for mic permission.
